[P2] Approach: enforce rule 4 with behavioral validation

These assertions only inspect source text. Changing the handler's `except StepError` to `except ValueError` leaves every committed check satisfied, although the required `payment failed` wrapper is no longer raised. Inverting the new log-group guard also escapes the tests. The reported manual run does not provide a regression test, and the description says the pinned cloud suite skips telemetry-2. This violates rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it.” Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and choose validation based on observable handler behavior.
